mode: Content-identical GitHub API snapshot when direct Git transport is unavailable
matchRule: Remote snapshot tree must exactly equal the complete local final tree before branch creation
commitIdentity: GitHub API authors the remote snapshot commit, so its SHA may differ from the local commit although every file is identical
preservation: Keep the local branch/history/worktree and all other remote branches. No force push. A future normal push of the local work branch can remain independent of this snapshot.
